name: commandcode-ai
title: Command Code AI
description: Use your Command Code subscription in Raycast — Command Code models in AI Chat, Quick AI and AI Commands
author: alhassanaraouf

commands.name: ask-commandcode-ai
commands.title: Ask Command Code AI
commands.subtitle: Command Code
commands.description: Ask questions using Command Code models, with conversation history

commands.name: refresh-models
commands.title: Refresh Models
commands.subtitle: Command Code
commands.description: Fetch the latest Command Code model list and update Raycast AI's model picker

preferences.title: API Key
preferences.name: COMMANDCODE_API_KEY
preferences.description: Command Code API key from Command Code Studio. Leave empty to use the key from the Command Code CLI (`cmd login`, stored in ~/.commandcode/auth.json).

preferences.title: Default Model
preferences.name: COMMANDCODE_MODEL
preferences.description: Model preselected in Ask Command Code AI, e.g. deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash or claude-sonnet-5

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
